title: DEPARTMENT’S REPORT dated October 20, 2026, relative to Immigration Update for September
text:
[5. REGULAR AGENDA ITEMS]
DEPARTMENT’S REPORT dated October 20, 2026, relative to Immigration Update for September
  2026, as set forth.  [BPC #26-330]

  Recommendation(s) for Board action:

  APPROVE the Department’s Report and TRANSMIT to the Mayor.
summary: The commission is asked to approve the department's September 2026 immigration update and send it to the mayor.

details.action: approve report and transmit to mayor
